html:
Located on serene Pamban Island in Tamil Nadu, Rameswaram is one of the sacred Char Dham pilgrimage destinations and home to one of India's twelve Jyotirlingas. With SR Tours & Travels, our private Rameswaram tour packages from Chennai let families and senior citizens travel peacefully in clean AC cars, Innova Crystas, or Tempo Travellers without the hassle of train waitlists or crowded buses.

1. Must-Visit Sacred & Scenic Places in Rameswaram

  • Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple & 22 Holy Theerthams: Experience the divine Jyotirlinga darshan and walk through the world's longest sculpted temple corridor.
  • Agni Theertham: Holy sea bath right beside the eastern tower of the temple.
  • Dhanushkodi & Arichal Munai (Ram Setu): Breathtaking coastal road to the meeting point of the Bay of Bengal and the Indian Ocean.
  • Pamban Bridge: Iconic sea bridge connecting mainland Tamil Nadu to Rameswaram Island.
  • Panchmukhi Hanuman Temple, Ramar Padam & APJ Abdul Kalam Memorial: Spiritual and inspirational stops loved by all age groups.

2. Recommended 3-Day Chennai – Madurai – Rameswaram – Thiruchendur Itinerary

Day 1: Chennai to Madurai & Rameswaram

Early morning doorstep pickup in Chennai via NH 38 / Trichy highway. Optional darshan at Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple en route, followed by scenic crossing over Pamban Bridge and overnight stay in Rameswaram.

Day 2: Rameswaram Temple, 22 Theerthams & Dhanushkodi

Early morning Agni Theertham bath, 22 Holy Theerthams snanam, and Sri Ramanathaswamy Temple darshan. Afternoon excursion to Dhanushkodi, Ram Setu viewpoint, Panchmukhi Hanuman Temple, and Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam National Memorial.

Day 3: Thiruchendur / Return to Chennai

Optional visit to Thiruchendur Subramanya Swamy Temple (or Devipattinam Navabashanam) before a relaxed highway drive back to Chennai.

4. Frequently Asked Questions – Rameswaram Tour Packages

How far is Rameswaram from Chennai by road?

Rameswaram is approximately 560 km from Chennai (around 9–10 hours via Trichy–Karaikudi–Ramanathapuram highway), making a 2-day or 3-day trip very comfortable.

What is the best time to visit Rameswaram?

October to March offers the most pleasant coastal weather, though temple darshan is open year-round.
